description: Defines the IUSBMassStorage interface for managing USB mass storage devices, including device info, mount info, partition info, and notifications.

classes.name: IUSBMassStorage
classes.description: Interface for USB mass storage device management, including device info, mount points, partition info, and notifications.

classes.name: IUSBMassStorage::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for device mounted and unmounted events.

classes.name: USBStorageDeviceInfo
classes.description: Structure containing device path and name.

classes.name: USBStorageMountInfo
classes.description: Structure containing mount point details, flags, and file system type.

classes.name: USBStoragePartitionInfo
classes.description: Structure containing partition details such as size, sectors, and file system.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB mass storage events.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently mounted USB storage devices.

methods.name: GetMountPoints
methods.description: Retrieves mount points for a specified device.

methods.name: GetPartitionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves partition information for a specified mount path.
